The perspective distortion is consistent with the geometric depth auditor's findings of spatial warping. However, the Router may have underestimated the severity of the structural issues in the musicians' poses, as the pose auditor indicates widespread uncertainty in limb positioning. I would adjust the severity of the structural collapse to 3.5 and note additional potential artifacts in the musicians' lower limbs.
